heading.title: Companies authorised to register, and unregistered companies

article.title: Power to wind up foreign companies, although dissolved.
article.content: Where a body corporate incorporated outside India which has been carrying on business in India, ceases to carry on business in India, it may be wound up as an unregistered company under this Part, notwithstanding that the body corporate has been dissolved or otherwise ceased to exist as such under or by virtue of the laws of the country under which it was incorporated.
article.html:
376Power to wind up foreign companies, although dissolved.

Section 376 · Chapter XXI · Part II · page 201 of the Act

Where a body corporate incorporated outside India which has been carrying on business in India, ceases to carry on business in India, it may be wound up as an unregistered company under this Part, notwithstanding that the body corporate has been dissolved or otherwise ceased to exist as such under or by virtue of the laws of the country under which it was incorporated.
